name: Bloom: Content repurposing (blog → main image + 3 socials)

parameters.url: ={{ (() => { const b = $json.brand_session_id; if (!b || b.startsWith('REPLACE_WITH')) { throw new Error('Set your Bloom brand id in the "Brand config" node (brand_session_id field). See the README Setup section.'); } return 'https://www.trybloom.ai/api/v1/brands/' + b; })() }}

={{ (() => { const imageId = $json.data?.ids?.[0] ?? $json.data?.imageIds?.[0]; if (!imageId) { throw new Error('Bloom generate response is missing an image id.'); } return `https://www.trybloom.ai/api/v1/images/${imageId}?wait=true&timeout=295`; })() }}

={{ $json.data.status === 'completed' && $json.data.imageUrl ? $json.data.imageUrl : (() => { throw new Error('Bloom image not ready (status: ' + ($json.data.status || 'unknown') + '). Increase the wait timeout or check the generation.'); })() }}
